purpose: Large retrieval and answer benchmark for the 23-passage corpus: one question in six styles for every passage, two-passage questions, questions answered by what the corpus leaves out, broad visitor questions, and questions that must be refused.

protocol.firstRunPolicy: Checksum-locked before any retriever was run on it.
